name: Frasle Mobility S.A.
summary: Frasle Mobility S.A. provides friction materials for braking systems and other products in Brazil, England, Argentina, the United States, China, India, Uruguay, Holland, Chile, Colombia, Germany, South America, and internationally. It operates through Automakers and Replacement segments. The company offers brake linings for commercial vehicles, brake pads for commercial vehicles, automobiles, motorcycles and small aircraft, brake linings for automobiles, railway shoes, brake shoes for commercial vehicles and automobiles, clutch linings, molded linings, and universal plates and industrial products; brake disc, drum, master cylinder, servos, wheel cylinder, wheel hubs, repairs, actuators, and …
